title: Fix completed date sorting
summary: Completed preview rows now expose a normalized completion timestamp sort key, and the WebView Completed table stores it on the Completed cell for shared table sorting.
reason: The shared table sorter compared compact display text such as "Jun 30 12:50 AM", which could put AM rows ahead of later PM rows and made oldest/newest review unreliable.
behavior_before: Clicking the Completed column sorted by visible text/number fragments when rows used compact month/day/time display strings.
behavior_after: Clicking the Completed column sorts by the backend-normalized ISO timestamp while keeping the compact display text visible.
manual_validation: python -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke -q - failed before Completed sort assertion on unrelated queue-filter-summary text expectation in current dirty worktree
rollback_plan: Remove completed_at_sort_key from completed preview rows, remove the Completed cell data-sort-value assignment, and return shared table sorting to visible cell text only.
notes:
Completed timestamp cells now carry backend ISO sort keys; shared table sort uses cell data-sort-value before display text.
Refreshed generated summaries for completed timestamp sorting files.
